prior_source: 3-way reconciled: heuristic guess (contradicted, rho=-0.67), thread reconstruction (supported, rho=+0.87), rigorous ML+options-SME referee.
note: PROVISIONAL priors. Target is providers' SELF-REPORTED exits (unverified) — absolute EV% is NOT trustworthy; only the ROBUSTNESS RANKING is. Trust is conservative/compressed (33-58, no provider earns HIGH on trust alone — naive copy is ~breakeven-minus after slippage). Order = prince_small>=jmt>prince>sulker>optionking>mike, validated across every silent-loser assumption. Mike integrity-capped (recap 82% win vs ~20% real). Per-ticker & timing knobs REMOVED (ML: noise, R2=-0.22). Next real upgrade: reprice every trade from market.py to end the self-report dependency. Will re-fit from YOUR closed_trades.jsonl as real fills accumulate.

exit_rule.note: VERIFIED across all 6: winners give back ~15-19% of premium from peak to exit. Scale ~60% at +30-40%, trail rest 25% off peak.

exit_by_provider._note: ML: a hard mechanical stop HELPS high-silent fire-hose books (mike +37, ok +26, sulker +6 pts/trade) but HURTS the managed ones (jmt -5.6, prince -3.2, p_small -22) — a tight stop clips their real winners. So stop style is PER-PROVIDER. follow_loose=lean on THEIR trims + a loose safety stop; own_hard=YOUR tight stop is the edge; underlying=stop on the STOCK level (swings).

jmt.note: Most robust usable provider: SPY-only (priceable, tight spreads), lowest silent rate, well narrated. Marginal +EV even under stress. Pre-set your own stop — he goes quiet on losers.

prince_small.note: Only book that stays positive if ALL silent trades are total losses — but THIN (n~300) and low volume. Best hand-holding (2.3 updates/trade), states stops. Directional, not a primary engine.

prince.note: Actually cuts losers (least hidden-loss bias). Diversified liquid stocks, swing horizon. Positive but not robust to worst-case; size for his $1.50+ premiums.

sulker.note: ~Breakeven overall; median trade is a $0.52 lotto (66% silent). Honest recaps + manages, but only his LIQUID IWM/SPX calls are worth copying — skip the cheap lottos.

optionking.note: Zero-to-negative live EV, 76% silent, 3 cuts / 2981 entries. Only usable if YOU enforce hard stops on his single-stock entries.

mike.note: INTEGRITY-CAPPED: recap claims 82% win, reality ~20% — NEVER trust his exits/recaps/targets, they may be fabricated. Discretionary 1-lot only, YOUR hard stop (25%) is the sole exit. Filter to liquid SPX/index names; skip the cheap lottos (31%). Auto-killed if last-20 real EV turns negative.
